summary: Tested CRE CRM backlog features: Deal Activity, Asset Types, Admin Approval Signup, Calendar Recurrence, Login page cleanup. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend components verified working. Fixed 2 bugs during testing.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Reference to undefined variable 'isLogin' on line 302 - would cause JavaScript error on login page
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Removed the conditional check since login page is now login-only (no signup toggle)

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Create Event modal was missing Repeat dropdown and Repeat Until fields (only Edit form had them)
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added recurrence_rule and recurrence_end fields to Create Event modal

deal_activity.backend: GET /api/deals/{deal_id}/activity and POST endpoints exist, require auth (403 without)
deal_activity.frontend: DealActivityLog component exists with comment input and activity feed

asset_types.backend: Full CRUD endpoints /api/asset-types exist, all require auth
asset_types.frontend: AssetTypesSection in Settings page with add/edit/delete UI

admin_approval_signup.backend: POST /api/auth/signup creates request (not user), GET/POST signup-requests endpoints exist
admin_approval_signup.frontend: Login page has 'Request Access' link/form, no dead signup code

calendar_recurrence.backend: POST /api/calendar/events accepts recurrence_rule and recurrence_end fields
calendar_recurrence.frontend: Create and Edit event forms have Repeat dropdown and Repeat Until date picker
calendar_recurrence.database: calendar_events table has recurrence_rule, recurrence_end columns

login_page_cleanup.frontend: Login page has Request Access flow, Forgot Password link, no dead signup button

deal_details_tabs.frontend: DealDetails page shows Property Details and Activity tabs always, Closing tab conditional on stage

critical_code_review_comments: Login.js had undefined 'isLogin' variable - fixed during testing
Calendar Create Event modal was missing recurrence fields - fixed during testing
All new DB tables (deal_activity, asset_types, signup_requests) properly created
Activity tab in DealDetails always visible (line 447), Closing tab conditional on stage name (lines 443-444)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Login page, Request Access form verified working)

test_credentials: Using Supabase service key for direct DB access tests
seed_data_creation: Test signup request created during test_signup_creates_request_not_user test
